question: Is vm.gl down, or unreachable only from one path? On 2026-10-30 TCP 443 and 80 timed out twice about 12 minutes apart, and several reader services answered 502, 504 or 522, while one reader still returned the page text. A probe from a second vantage point, and a Wayback lookup (rate-limited on 2026-10-30), would settle it.
why: the record must not be marked dead on one vantage point; a persistent outage would change the verdict
